precondition: The agent asks for the customer's full name or account ID and clicks Pull up Account to load their record. This is a data-fetch mechanic shared by the opening step of most flows; the Phase 1 corpus does not encode it as a testable rule because no eligibility or amount depends on it -- it is not gated, it is prerequisite plumbing. (subcluster: purchase_dispute)
postcondition: No policy-governed consequence follows from this step alone; observed across 8 distinct subflows (bad_price_competitor, bad_price_yesterday, mistimed_billing_already_returned, mistimed_billing_never_bought, out_of_stock_general, out_of_stock_one_item...).
